results.name: fuzz differential vs xterm.js: 600 seeds × (40×12, 80×24), random chunking — zero unexplained mismatches
xterm.js itself crashes on CUP-past-corner + ED1 (oracle bug) — vt.ts survives it with a sane cursor
real programs through a real pty (ls, less, top, bash readline, ncurses app, git log --graph) == xterm.js under 2 chunkings
where xterm.js deviates, vt.ts follows xterm/VT510: DECALN, DECOM, CPR in pending wrap, EL0 at the margin
DECRQSS / DA / DSR replies match xterm.js exactly
key encoder == terminfo xterm-256color (cursor keys in keypad-transmit mode, F1–F63 with modifier banks, editing keys)
mouse encoder == xterm.js core mouse service (X10/1000/1002/1003 × legacy/SGR × buttons, wheel, drag, modifiers)
hostile output is bounded: REP / parameter floods, 10 MB stream, malformed UTF-8, OSC 52, title cap, DCS inert
resize keeps the cursor row on screen and bounds everything; scrollback only from the primary screen
reflow: 300 seeds × 4 width changes — every logical line equals the INPUT's line (ground truth) and xterm.js's reflow wherever xterm.js itself keeps the input
documented divergence: xterm.js does not reflow the cursor's line, so narrowing cuts it; vt.ts re-wraps it (as VTE and kitty do)
reflow round trip: 70 → 41 → 70 columns restores every cell, colour and the cursor; the alternate screen is cut, not reflowed
